subject: MAP: Post-signature rollout, canary windows & training (Velaris Health)
messages:
From: Jared Collins <jared.collins@velarishealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Mehta <priya.mehta@velarishealth.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Post-signature rollout & canary windows (Velaris Health)

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks again for the quick close this week. Attached is our initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft to embed the post-signature work: rollout phases, canary/validation windows, migration cutover, and the training cadence. High level items: 

- Target production go-live: 2028-09-15
- Proposed canary validation window: 2028-08-28 to 2028-09-01
- Training: two instructor-led sessions + on-demand materials between 2028-08-20 and 2028-09-10
- Success criteria: <5% error rate at 95th perc. latency during canary, zero-data loss for migration trials

Can you confirm the canary dates and flag any required dependencies (test accounts, SOC2 artifacts, IP allowlist, contact for emergency escalation)? Also attaching the MAP draft (Velaris_MAP_v1.pdf).

If useful, we can book a 30-min alignment call early next week.

Best,
Jared Collins
Senior PM, Integrations
Velaris Health

Attachment: Velaris_MAP_v1.pdf (mutual action plan draft, 6 pages)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Jared Collins <jared.collins@velarishealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Jul 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Post-signature rollout & canary windows (Velaris Health)

Jared — thanks for the draft and clear timeline. Two quick notes from our side:

1) Canary week conflict: the 8/28 week overlaps a company holiday for one of our ops leads. Would you be open to moving the canary forward by one week (2028-08-21 to 2028-08-25)? That gives us room for a second rehearsal.
2) Required artifacts: please share SOC2 report or attestation URL and an initial list of accounts we should mirror for the canary (test tenant IDs).

From a readiness perspective we need to validate these technical items before we lock dates: 
- Confirmation of expected QPS profile during canary (approx. peak / sustained)
- Test data set and whether PII will be included in canary runs (we prefer masked copies)
- List of firewall/IP ranges for allowlisting (we will provide ours below)

I attached a starting canary plan workbook (canary_plan_v1.xlsx) with suggested checkpoints and owner columns.

Propose we do a 30-min sync on Tuesday (2028-07-24) 11:00–11:30 PT to finalize dates. Does that work for you?

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head, Strategic Onboarding
Redwood Inference

Attachment: canary_plan_v1.xlsx (checklist + timeline)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Jared Collins <jared.collins@velarishealth.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Jul 2028 13:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Post-signature rollout & canary windows (Velaris Health)

Adding a few technical constraints and asks from infra: 

- Canary throughput: recommend we stage two parallel worker pools and cap test traffic to 40% of expected peak for first 48 hours, then raise to 70% if metrics are green.
- KV cache warmup: to meet latency SLOs we need a pre-warm step using representative prefixes (Marcus will send a small script).
- Staging instance: we prefer a dedicated staging cluster (not shared) for the canary phase. We can provision s-2 nodes for the week.
- Allowlist: please add the following IP ranges to your firewall for test traffic and callbacks: 34.72.11.0/24, 34.72.12.0/24, 34.72.13.0/24.
- Test accounts: provide 3 non-prod tenant IDs and one admin user with limited PII access.

Attachment: staging_network_rules.txt (stub containing recommended ports and CIDR)

If those items are OK, we can lock the earlier canary week (8/21–8/25) Vanessa proposed.

—Marcus
Principal Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference

- Can we limit live data in the first two days and use masked copies for the pre-warm?
- Training: prefer sessions on 2028-08-22 10:00–11:30 PT and 2028-08-24 14:00–15:30 PT (instructor-led). Can Redwood provide a trainer and slide deck?

We will upload SOC2 attestation to the shared Drive by EOD tomorrow and list the three non-prod tenant IDs in the spreadsheet.

Thanks,

Team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached is the updated MAP (Velaris_MAP_v2.pdf) which embeds the agreed canary week (2028-08-21 to 2028-08-25), the staging checklist, and the training schedule. Summary of owners and immediate next steps:

- Velaris Onboarding (Priya): upload SOC2 attestation and three non-prod tenant IDs by 2028-07-26.
- Redwood enablement (Laura): deliver slide deck + trainer assignment by 2028-08-10.
- Joint: schedule daily 15-min standups during canary (2028-08-21 to 2028-08-25) and a post-canary retro on 2028-09-02.

Please find the Drive link with the MAP and canary workbook here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3VelarisOnboard

I'll send calendar invites for the training sessions and the 30-min alignment on 2028-07-24 11:00 PT. If anything changes please flag in this thread.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz

Redwood Inference
